system.description:
Similar to a charm person spell, this effect causes one tree, six medium-sized bushes, 12 small shrubs, or 24 small plants to become friends of the magic-user (no saving throw). However, a plant-like monster (treant, shrieker, etc.) may make a saving throw vs. spells to resist the effect.

The charmed plants will understand and obey all commands of the magic-user, as long as the tasks are within their ability (including the entangling of passers-by within range, but not including movement, sensing alignment, etc.).

The plants will remain charmed for six months, until the charm is dispelled, or until winter (when they sleep). (This spell is quite useful around a stronghold, both inside and out, especially when used after a 4th level growth of plants spell, and possibly a permanence as well.)
system.effect: Charms one tree or multiple smaller plants
